Usage: actual rules [options] [command]

Manage transaction rules

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list                   List all rules
  payee-rules <payeeId>  List rules for a specific payee
  create [options]       Create a new rule
  update [options]       Update a rule
  delete <id>            Delete a rule
  help [command]         display help for command
